SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BOARD B INNER JOIN ADS A ON B.BRD_NO = A.BRD_NO WHERE 1=1
AND B.BRD_TITL_NM LIKE '%' || #{detailSearch.searchAdsTitle} || '%'
AND B.MBR_CD LIKE '%' || #{detailSearch.searchAdsWriter} || '%'
AND A.ADS_STATUS_CODE = #{detailSearch.searchAdsStatusCode}
AND A.ADS_BP LIKE '%' || #{detailSearch.searchAdsBp} || '%'
AND A.ADS_PIC LIKE '%' || #{detailSearch.searchAdsPic} || '%'
AND A.ADS_PIC_TELNO LIKE '%' || #{detailSearch.searchAdsPicTelno} || '%'

SELECT B.BRD_NO ,B.BRD_TITL_NM ,B.BRD_CONT ,B.MBR_CD ,B.BRD_PBLS_DTM ,B.BRD_VW_CNT ,A.ADS_ID ,A.BRD_NO AS ADS_BRD_NO ,A.ADS_STATUS_CODE ,A.ADS_BP ,A.ADS_PIC ,A.ADS_PIC_TELNO ,A.ADS_REQ_PBLS_START_DT ,A.ADS_REQ_PBLS_END_DT FROM BOARD B INNER JOIN ADS A ON B.BRD_NO = A.BRD_NO WHERE B.BRD_NO = #{brdNo}
